description: This file defines a Redux-Observable epic for handling failed updates in the FreeCodeCamp project. It manages retrying failed challenge updates, batching them with staggered delays, and updating the store accordingly.

methods.name: delay
methods.description: A helper function that delays execution of a callback by a specified time using setTimeout.

methods.name: isSubmitable
methods.description: Determines if a failure object is submitable based on challenge type and presence of a solution.

methods.name: failedUpdateEpic
methods.description: Main epic function that listens for specific actions, manages failed updates, retries them with staggered delays, and updates the store.
